 Torino vs Como Serie A Torino Como Torino 1-3 Como: Adams, Ramon, Nico Paz and Baturina on target
 Como come from behind to beat Torino 3-1 in tonight's 20.45 match at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino in the ninth round of Serie A . The result leaves Ignazio Abate 's Torino eighth on 13 points, while Cesc Fabregas's side move up to 20 points. 
 After a bright start, Como see a Douvikas goal ruled out for offside by the narrowest of margins. They also appeal over a suspicious challenge in the box by Braganca on Da Cunha. Adams then puts Torino ahead and they finish the half strongly, playing aggressively without taking any major risks. Como enjoy increasingly sustained possession after the break, with three efforts hitting the crossbar (one for the hosts and two for the visitors). Between the 84th and 92nd minutes, Fabregas's side turn the game around. Nico Paz sets up Ramon before scoring a superb header. Baturina adds a third deep into stoppage time. 
 Torino-Como 1-3 
 Scorers : 24' Adams (T), 84' Ramon (C), Paz (C), 92' Baturina (C) 
 Goals and highlights
 92' - Vlasic makes a mistake and Baturina pounces, placing a right-footed shot into the net for Fabregas's side's third goal 
 87' - Couto's cross finds Nico Paz, whose superb header puts Como ahead 
 83' - The visitors launch a fine counter-attack, but Paz fires a left-footed shot just wide of the post 
 81' - Nico Paz drives in a cross and Ramon heads home the equaliser 
 77' - Baturina's cross-shot from the left hits the crossbar 
 74' - The Granata break forward and Gineitis hits a left-footed shot across goal. Sanchez saves with his foot, turning the ball behind for a corner 
 71' - From distance, Nico Paz tries an ambitious effort, but sends it over 
 68' - Perri does well to prevent an own goal after Comuzzo gets a touch on Couto's cross 
 67' - Vlasic tries his luck with a left-footed shot, but sends it over 
 61' - From the resulting corner, Simeone heads against the crossbar and Sanchez palms the ball away 
 60' - Sanchez saves Belghali's shot after a fine move involving Simeone, Adams and Vlasic 
 57' - Belghali breaks clear with a driving run, but miskicks his shot 
 54' - Caqueret plays a one-two with Paz, then hits the crossbar with a right-footed shot 
 45' - A weak header from Caqueret drops gently into the Granata goalkeeper's arms 
 42' - Da Cunha hits a fine left-footed shot from outside the box, narrowly missing the target to Perri's left 
 32' - Ramon forces Perri into a save with a close-range header 
 26' - Douvikas goes close to equalising with a right-footed touch from close range 
 24' - Adams scores with a left-footed volley after Fitz-Jim performs a step-over and finds his team-mate with the outside of his foot 
 20' - Sanchez turns a fine effort from Vlasic behind for a corner 
 17' - Braganca makes suspicious contact with Da Cunha in the Granata penalty area. Da Cunha goes down, but the referee and VAR allow play to continue, prompting protests 
 10' - Belghali weaves through on a superb run and hits a right-footed shot that Sanchez saves 
 5' - Douvikas has a goal ruled out for a marginal offside 
 Line-ups and match details
 Torino 1-3 Como 
 Goalscorers : 24' Adams (T), 84' Ramon (C), Paz (C), 92' Baturina (C) 
 Torino (3-4-1-2): Perri; Coco, Ismajli, Comuzzo; Belghali (89' Oristanio), Fitz-Jim (55' Gineitis), Braganca (89' Ilkhan), Cacciamani (55' Patterson); Vlasic; Adams, Simeone (75' Kulenovic). Coach: Abate 
 Como (4-2-3-1): Sanchez; Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Valle (71' Kaiki); Perrone (58' Addai, 79' Ricci), Milla (79' Smolcic); Da Cunha, Paz, Caqueret (58' Baturina); Douvikas. Coach: Fabregas 
 Referee : Collu 
 Booked : Belghali (T) 
 Sent off : -
